_comment: v2 canonical talent design (TALENT_ICON_ATLAS_SPEC_2026-06-27) + WO-676 strategic branches: knight = 32 nodes across three branches — WAR (hero combat; the legacy 20 + Venombrand, branch key absent = war), STEWARD (economy, 6 nodes, ids knight.s*), BULWARK (defensive structures, 5 nodes, ids knight.b*) — plus 8+3 Shared Universal. Node id = <hero>.t<tier>n<slot> (branch nodes: s/b prefix); iconPath = Talents/<hero>/<hero>_NN (NN 21-32 = WO-676 art follow-up, sprites pending). Prereq = same-slot tier below / same-branch chain. ALL THREE heroes stored (canonical); only KNIGHT effects are wired for V1 (solo Knight north star) — mage/ranger load as data+icons, effects no-op until V2. Ally-dependent Knight effects are no-op in solo V1 (any self-portion applies) and tagged '(allies — V2)'; '(... — V-later)' marks a behavioural handler not yet built. STEWARD/BULWARK effect types are summed by HeroTalentModifiers (HeroTalentEffectTypes consts); their consumer reads land in lanes A1/A2 (WO-676 §A).

mage._comment: WO-861 A1 (owner-approved 2026-08-02) — Thrain, the ranged glass cannon. notes: v2 + WO-676 + 2026-08-16 SHAPE LAW (owner ruling): every tree starts from AT MOST THREE simple bases on the bottom row and branches WIDER as it rises - simple at the base, the path fork in the middle, specialised leaves on top. 83 nodes (knight 32 = WAR 21 + STEWARD 6 + BULWARK 5, five rows 3/7/8/7/7; ranger 20 and mage 20, four rows each - ranger 3/5/6/6, mage 3/6/6/5; shared 11 in three rows 3/4/4). Node ids, names, tiers, slots, costs, icons and effects are UNCHANGED - the reshape moved x/y and re-pointed prerequisites ONLY, so no save-side unlock is orphaned. x/y are an ORDERING HINT consumed by HeroSkillTreePanelMvvm.SolveGraphLatticePx, not shipped geometry; y ascends downward, so a prerequisite ALWAYS carries a LARGER y than its child. Tier costs 1/2/3/5 Wisdom; shared nodes 2 each (skill trio 1). V1 wires KNIGHT effects only (HeroTalentModifiers); mage/ranger stored as data+icons. Tier4 capstone exclusivity (one per hero) spans branches - Bountiful Banners / Warden of Elarion compete with the five WAR capstones (WO-676 law 2). Owner-open: Wisdom curve, shared-pool cap - see TALENT_ICON_ATLAS_SPEC_2026-06-27 sec.7.
